## Call and compile AQIM data

Get all AQIM data that is relevant and make sure it is geolocated

```{r ARM AQIM data}

#-- Connect to ARM ---- 
#ARM data base version 2
geo_conn <- dbConnect(odbc::odbc(),.connection_string = 
                      "Driver=SQL Server;
                        Server=AAP00VA3PPQSQL0\\MSSQLSERVER,1433;
                        Database=GeoLocations;
                        trusted_connection=yes")

rg_cols <- c("Operational", "State", "Type", "Latitude", "Longitude")

#-- Pull AQIM inspection records from ARM  ---- 
system.time(rg_dat <- tbl(geo_conn, sql("SELECT * FROM [GeoLocations].[dbo].[tbl_Processing_Facilities_Regulated_Garbage]")) |> 
              dplyr::select(all_of(rg_cols)) |> 
              collect() |>
              dplyr::filter(!grepl("Not|No|Out|Cease", Operational)))

```

```{r save lat lon}

# Create a function to simplify the types
simplify_type <- function(type_string) {
  if (grepl("steriliz", type_string, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return("Sterilizer")
  } else if (grepl("incinerat", type_string, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return("Incinerator")
  } else {
    return(type_string)  # Keep other types as is
  }
}

# Apply the function to create a new simplified type column
rg_dat$SimpleType <- sapply(rg_geo$Type, simplify_type)

setwd(here::here("output","regulated garbage map"))
write.csv(rg_dat, "regulated_garbage_facilities.csv")

```

```{r}
  label = paste(rg_geo$SimpleType, "-", rg_geo$State),

)

rg_map_simplified
```

# Gather geolocation data
```{r geolocation data}
#-- Connect to ARM ---- 
#ARM data base version 2
db_conn <- dbConnect(odbc::odbc(),.connection_string = 
                      "Driver=SQL Server;
                        Server=AAP00VA3PPQSQL0\\MSSQLSERVER,1433;
                        Database=PPQ_AQI_ARMDMV2;
                        trusted_connection=yes")


brg_loc_cols <- c("ID",
                "NAME",
                "SITE",
                "PHYSICAL_ADDRESS_ID",
                "MAIL_ADDRESS_ID",
                'CBP_PORT_NUMBER',
                "IATA_CODE")
cbp_poe_cols <- c("CBP_NAME", "CBP_CODE", "LAT", "LON", "Port of Entry Name")
ppq_facilities_cols <- c("LocationName", "PPQCode", "City", "State", "Longitude", "Latitude")
loc_280_cols <- c("LOCATION", "ARM_InspectionLocationName", "Latitude", "Longitude")


```


# gather coords from difference sources

```{r}
# BRG2_LOCATION
brg_loc <- tbl(db_conn, sql("SELECT * FROM [PPQ_AQI_ARMDMV2].[ARMDATADM].[SYS2_BRG_LOCATION]")) |> 
               dplyr::select(all_of(brg_loc_cols)) |> 
              collect()


cbp_poe <- tbl(geo_conn, sql("SELECT * FROM [GeoLocations].[dbo].[tbl_CBP_POEs]")) |> 
              dplyr::select(all_of(cbp_poe_cols)) |> 
              collect()


ppq_facilities <- tbl(db_conn, sql("SELECT * FROM [GeoLocations].[dbo].[tbl_PPQ_Facilities]")) |> dplyr::select(all_of(ppq_facilities_cols)) |> collect()


rg_volume_yrly_loc <- rg_volume_yrly |> left_join(brg_loc, by = c("LOCATION_ID" = "ID"))


# Step 1: Join with CBP POE data first
rg_volume_yrly_geo <- rg_volume_yrly_loc %>%
  left_join(cbp_poe, by = c("CBP_PORT_NUMBER" = "CBP_CODE")) %>%
  # Create initial LAT/LON columns that might be filled
  rename(
    CBP_LAT = LAT,
    CBP_LON = LON,
    CBP_PORT_NAME = `Port of Entry Name`
  )

# Step 2: Join with PPQ facilities for rows still missing coordinates
rg_volume_yrly_geo <- rg_volume_yrly_geo %>%
  left_join(
    ppq_facilities %>% 
      dplyr::select(LocationName, Latitude, Longitude) %>%
      rename(
        PPQ_LAT = Latitude,
        PPQ_LON = Longitude
      ),
    by = c("LOCATION_NAME" = "LocationName")
  )

# Step 3: Create combined coordinate columns, prioritizing CBP data
rg_volume_yrly_geo <- rg_volume_yrly_geo %>%
  mutate(
    final_LAT = coalesce(CBP_LAT, PPQ_LAT),
    final_LON = coalesce(CBP_LON, PPQ_LON)
  )

# Step 4: For remaining missing coordinates, use IATA code if available
missing_coords <- rg_volume_yrly_geo %>%
  filter(is.na(final_LAT) | is.na(final_LON)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(IATA_CODE))

if(nrow(missing_coords) > 0) {
  # Option 1: Use tidygeocoder package if available
  if(requireNamespace("tidygeocoder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    iata_coords <- missing_coords %>%
      dplyr::select(IATA_CODE) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      mutate(
        # Look up IATA codes - this creates lat/lng columns
        query = paste("airport", IATA_CODE)
      ) %>%
      tidygeocoder::geocode(address = query, method = "osm")
    
    # Join the results back
    rg_volume_yrly_geo <- rg_volume_yrly_geo %>%
      left_join(
        iata_coords %>% 
          dplyr::select(IATA_CODE, lat, long) %>%
          rename(IATA_LAT = lat, IATA_LON = long),
        by = "IATA_CODE"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        final_LAT = coalesce(final_LAT, IATA_LAT),
        final_LON = coalesce(final_LON, IATA_LON)
      )
  } else {
    # Option 2: Create a simple example for manual IATA lookup
    cat("Found", nrow(missing_coords), "rows with IATA codes but no coordinates.\n")
    cat("Consider using the 'airportr' or 'tidygeocoder' package to look up these codes.\n")
    print(missing_coords %>% dplyr::select(IATA_CODE) %>% distinct())
  }
}
```

```{r}
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("final_LON", "final_LAT"), crs = 4326) |> st_transform(crs = 5070)
```

```{r}
library(tigris)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)

us_bounds_sf <- readRDS(here::here("output","intermediate files", "US hex grid","us_bounds.rds"))

# # Check if us_bounds_sf already exists
# if (!exists("us_bounds_sf")) {
#   # Get US states and territories
#   us_all <- tigris::states(cb = FALSE) 
  
#   # Create a simplified boundary
#   us_bounds_sf <- us_all %>%
#     st_union() %>%
#     st_simplify(dTolerance = 1000) %>%  # Simplify to avoid complex geometries
#     st_transform(4326) %>%              # Ensure WGS84 projection
#     st_buffer(0) %>%                    # Fix potential topology issues
#     st_as_sf()
# }

# Create hexagonal grid covering the continental US only (for simplicity)
us_grid <- readRDS(here::here("output","intermediate files", "US hex grid","us_grid.rds"))

# Check validity of both datasets
cat("Hex grid valid:", all(st_is_valid(us_grid)), "\n")
cat("Points valid:", all(st_is_valid(rg_volume_yrly_geo_sf)), "\n")

# Fix any invalid geometries if needed
us_grid <- st_make_valid(us_grid)
rg_volume_yrly_geo_sf <- st_make_valid(rg_volume_yrly_geo_sf)

# Use a different approach for aggregation that's more robust
# 1. Find which hex each point falls in
point_hex_overlay <- st_intersects(rg_volume_yrly_geo_sf, us_grid, sparse = TRUE)
point_hex_ids <- sapply(point_hex_overlay, function(x) if(length(x) > 0) x[1] else NA)

# 2. Add hex_id to points data
rg_volume_yrly_geo_sf$hex_id <- point_hex_ids

# 3. Aggregate by hex_id (non-spatial operation, more reliable)
hex_summary <- rg_volume_yrly_geo_sf %>%
  filter(!is.na(hex_id)) %>%
  group_by(hex_id) %>%
  summarize(
    total_count = sum(COUNT, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_points = n()
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 4. Join summary back to hex grid
hex_counts <- us_grid %>%
  st_join(hex_summary) %>%    
  filter(!is.na(total_count)) |> # Keep only hexagons with data
  mutate(
    total_count = replace_na(total_count, 0),
    n_points = replace_na(n_points, 0)
  )

# Visualize with mapview
hex_map <- mapview::mapview(
  hex_counts,
  zcol = "total_count",
  col.regions = viridis::viridis(50),
  alpha.regions = 0.7,
  layer.name = "RG Volume by Region"
)
```

# combine regulated garbage and locations of facilities

```{r}
# Create a combined map from scratch using leaflet directly
# First, extract data from the mapview objects
hex_data <- hex_counts
facility_data <- rg_geo

# Create a clean palette for the hexbins
hex_pal <- leaflet::colorNumeric(
  palette = "viridis",
  domain = hex_data$total_count
)

# Create a new leaflet map from scratch
combined_leaflet <- leaflet() %>%
  # Add basemap
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
  # Add hexbins first (on bottom)
  addPolygons(
    data = hex_data,
    fillColor = ~hex_pal(total_count),
    weight = 1,
    opacity = 0.7,
    color = "white",
    dashArray = "3",
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    popup = ~paste0("Count: ", round(total_count, 0)),
    group = "Regulated Garbage Volume"
  ) %>%
  # Add facility points on top
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = facility_data,
    radius = 5,
    color = ~colorFactor("Set1", facility_data$SimpleType)(SimpleType),
    stroke = FALSE,
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    popup = ~paste0("Type: ", SimpleType, "<br>State: ", State),
    group = "Regulated Garbage Facilities"
  ) %>%
  # Add legends
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = hex_pal,
    values = hex_data$total_count,
    title = "RG Volume"
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    colors = colorFactor("Set1", facility_data$SimpleType)(unique(facility_data$SimpleType)),
    labels = unique(facility_data$SimpleType),
    title = "Facility Types"
  ) %>%
  # Add layer controls
  addLayersControl(
    overlayGroups = c("Regulated Garbage Volume", "Regulated Garbage Facilities"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  setView(lng = -95, lat = 39, zoom = 4)

# Save this map
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(
  combined_leaflet,
  file = file.path(output_dir, "combined_map_direct.html"),
  selfcontained = TRUE
)

# Show the path
cat("Combined map saved to:", file.path(output_dir, "combined_map_direct.html"))
```

```{r}
# Create a leaflet map of regulated garbage facilities
library(leaflet)
library(htmlwidgets)

# Create color palette based on facility type
pal <- colorFactor(palette = "Set1", domain = unique(rg_geo$Type))

mapview::mapview(rg_geo_filtered)

# Create the map
rg_map <- leaflet(rg_geo_filtered) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    radius = 5,
    color = ~pal(Type),
    stroke = FALSE,
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<strong>Type:</strong> ", Type, "<br>",
      "<strong>State:</strong> ", State, "<br>",
      "<strong>Operational:</strong> ", Operational
    ),
    label = ~paste(Type, "-", State)
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = pal,
    values = ~Type,
    title = "Facility Type"
  ) %>%
  setView(lng = -95, lat = 39, zoom = 4) %>%  # Center on the US
  addControl(
    html = "<h3>Regulated Garbage Processing Facilities</h3>",
    position = "topleft"
  ) %>%
  addScaleBar(position = "bottomleft")

# Create output directory if it doesn't exist
output_dir <- here::here("output", "maps")
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Save the map as an HTML file
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(
  rg_map,
  file = file.path(output_dir, "regulated_garbage_facilities_map.html"),
  selfcontained = TRUE  # Include all dependencies in the HTML file
)

# Print confirmation message
cat("Map saved to:", file.path(output_dir, "regulated_garbage_facilities_map.html"))
```
